clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Dario era accanto a una rete, a una sedia e a ovest di Luca.
clues.en: Dario was beside a net, a chair and west of Luca.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 8ª colonna e accanto a una corda.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 8th column and beside a rope coil.

clues.it: Luca era accanto a una corda e a una rete, ma non era accanto a una cassa.
clues.en: Luca was beside a rope coil and a net, but was not beside a crate.

clues.it: Tea era nella 6ª colonna e nella stessa stanza di Luca, ma non era accanto a un barile.
clues.en: Tea was in the 6th column and in the same room as Luca, but was not beside a barrel.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 5ª colonna e accanto a una corda.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 5th column and beside a rope coil.

clues.it: Anna era nella 3ª colonna, nella 7ª riga e a ovest di Ugo.
clues.en: Anna was in the 3rd column, in the 7th row and west of Ugo.

clues.it: Sergio era da solo in Cabina, ma non era accanto a un salvagente.
clues.en: Sergio was alone in the Cabin, but was not beside a life ring.

clues.it: Olga era accanto a una pianta e nella stessa stanza di Anna.
clues.en: Olga was beside a plant and in the same room as Anna.

general_clues.en: 4 in the west half of the grid.
4 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Dario lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Dario's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 1st.

steps.it: L'indizio di Ugo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 3ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Ugo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 3rd, column 8th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Bruno lascia una sola casella libera: riga 6ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Bruno's own clue leaves a single free square: row 6th, column 5th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Anna lascia una sola casella libera: riga 7ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Anna's own clue leaves a single free square: row 7th, column 3rd.

steps.it: Ugo può stare solo nella 3ª riga: escludendola, a Luca resta una sola casella: riga 4ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Ugo can only be in the 3rd row: ruling it out leaves Luca a single square: row 4th, column 9th.

steps.it: Luca può stare solo nella 4ª riga: escludendola, a Tea resta una sola casella: riga 5ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Luca can only be in the 4th row: ruling it out leaves Tea a single square: row 5th, column 6th.

steps.it: Anna può stare solo nella 3ª colonna: escludendola, a Olga resta una sola casella: riga 9ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Anna can only be in the 3rd column: ruling it out leaves Olga a single square: row 9th, column 4th.

steps.it: Olga può stare solo nella 9ª riga: escludendola, a Sergio resta una sola casella: riga 8ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Olga can only be in the 9th row: ruling it out leaves Sergio a single square: row 8th, column 7th.

steps.it: Marta può stare solo nella 2ª colonna.
steps.en: Marta can only be in the 2nd column.

steps.it: Nessun altro può stare nella 1ª riga, e lì a Marta resta una sola casella libera: la 2ª colonna.
steps.en: No one else can be in the 1st row, and it leaves Marta a single free square there: the 2nd column.
